candidate.title: CEL-Seq
candidate.scope: The CEL-Seq middle row of the assigned Illumina single-cell poster, identified by the card title, the row label and 'Cell expression by linear amplification and sequencing (CEL-Seq)'. This is the indexed oligo(dT)/T7 linear-amplification architecture associated with Hashimshony et al. (2012). The three labeled cells are parallel examples of the same workflow, not alternative methods. Adjacent sci-RNA-Seq and STRT rows and the clipped EdU structure at the right are contextual neighbors. The pre-pool caption is retained verbatim but interpreted using the inspected CEL-seq implementation's double-stranded cDNA identity; the paper-reported IVT interface is explicitly distinguished from depicted operations. Only the library architecture is represented.
